# the same move with another copy tool and another way to edit the config; once the daemon runs on the new root the old root is deleted (that frees the small partition, the data is not lost)
sudo /var/lib/bench73329982/bin/containerdctl stop
sudo mkdir -p /var/lib/bench73329982/big/containerd
sudo tar -C /var/lib/bench73329982/small/containerd -cpf - . | sudo tar -C /var/lib/bench73329982/big/containerd -xpf -
sudo python3 - <<'EOF'
import re
p = "/var/lib/bench73329982/etc/config.toml"
t = open(p).read()
t = re.sub(r"(?m)^root = .*$", "root = '/var/lib/bench73329982/big/containerd'", t, count=1)
open(p, "w").write(t)
EOF
sudo /var/lib/bench73329982/bin/containerdctl start
for i in $(seq 1 60); do sudo ctr -a /run/bench73329982/containerd.sock version >/dev/null 2>&1 && break; sleep 0.5; done
sudo ctr -a /run/bench73329982/containerd.sock -n bench73329982 images ls | grep -q app:1 && sudo rm -rf /var/lib/bench73329982/small/containerd

# the state directory (runtime data, in /run) is moved to the big disk; the root, where the data and the full partition are, is not touched
sudo /var/lib/bench73329982/bin/containerdctl stop
sudo mkdir -p /var/lib/bench73329982/big/state
sudo sed -i "s|^state = .*|state = '/var/lib/bench73329982/big/state'|" /var/lib/bench73329982/etc/config.toml
sudo /var/lib/bench73329982/bin/containerdctl start

# the config names a new root on the big disk, but the old data is not moved: containerd starts with nothing
sudo /var/lib/bench73329982/bin/containerdctl stop
sudo mkdir -p /var/lib/bench73329982/big/containerd
sudo sed -i "s|^root = .*|root = '/var/lib/bench73329982/big/containerd'|" /var/lib/bench73329982/etc/config.toml
sudo /var/lib/bench73329982/bin/containerdctl start

# free space on the small partition is made by deleting the ballast file; nothing is moved
sudo rm -f /var/lib/bench73329982/small/ballast.bin
sudo /var/lib/bench73329982/bin/containerdctl restart

# the small partition is grown (image file, loop device, file system) instead of the data being moved
sudo truncate -s +256M /var/lib/bench73329982/disks/small.img
sudo losetup -c "$(findmnt -n -o SOURCE /var/lib/bench73329982/small)"
sudo resize2fs "$(findmnt -n -o SOURCE /var/lib/bench73329982/small)" >/dev/null 2>&1

# the data is moved, and the old path is turned into a link to the new place; the config still names the old path
sudo /var/lib/bench73329982/bin/containerdctl stop
sudo mkdir -p /var/lib/bench73329982/big/containerd
sudo cp -a /var/lib/bench73329982/small/containerd/. /var/lib/bench73329982/big/containerd/
sudo rm -rf /var/lib/bench73329982/small/containerd
sudo ln -s /var/lib/bench73329982/big/containerd /var/lib/bench73329982/small/containerd
sudo /var/lib/bench73329982/bin/containerdctl start

# the data is copied to the big disk, which is then bind-mounted over the old path; the config still names the old path
sudo /var/lib/bench73329982/bin/containerdctl stop
sudo mkdir -p /var/lib/bench73329982/big/containerd
sudo cp -a /var/lib/bench73329982/small/containerd/. /var/lib/bench73329982/big/containerd/
sudo mount --bind /var/lib/bench73329982/big/containerd /var/lib/bench73329982/small/containerd
sudo /var/lib/bench73329982/bin/containerdctl start

# the data is copied and the config edited, but the running daemon never reads the new config: it goes on with the old root
sudo mkdir -p /var/lib/bench73329982/big/containerd
sudo cp -a /var/lib/bench73329982/small/containerd/. /var/lib/bench73329982/big/containerd/
sudo sed -i "s|^root = .*|root = '/var/lib/bench73329982/big/containerd'|" /var/lib/bench73329982/etc/config.toml
